resolution: Resolved the material-location confusion by separating the piece type picker from material browsing: the selected-piece structural picker is now labeled 'piece type', while material browsing opens a grouped material chooser sourced from the assignable material catalog. The building material browser now keeps the material list visible as a chooser lane instead of hiding material choices behind the piece picker.
